events.title: CRL Q1 Deep Dive: Portfolio Restructuring and Cost Initiatives Set Stage for Margin Expansion
events.body: Lab services company Charles River Laboratories (NYSE:CRL) reported Q1 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 1.2% year on year to $995.8 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.06 per share was 6% above analysts
